about.title: About me
about.description: Code, cyber and 3D printing: three fronts, one obsession — make it work.
about.p1: I'm Lucio. I take ugly problems — software, security, or something that needs to be printed — and push until they actually work.
about.p2: This site is security-by-design: build-time validation, strict headers and zero PII hanging in the HTML.
about.p3: I also do 3D printing: functional parts, custom prototypes and the sacred ritual of the first layer.
